text:
liz: quick sync on benchmark narrative drafts. want a cleaner lead for product-led customers — short and punchy. can we avoid heavy jargon in the hero post?

omar: agreed. hero: 2 lines + 1 stat. think: "Predictable latency. Lower token cost. Built for production." then stat: "Up to 10x lower per-token cost vs single-GPU baseline*" with a footnote.

neha: visual suggestion: one static hero chart (cost density heatmap) + an interactive slice selector on the deep-dive page so users can toggle chat/assistant/batch. interactive drives dwell time.

carl: add a quick explainer modal: how we measured 10s: model fp16, batch sizes, quantization flags, and caching on/off. transparency reduces skepticism.

liz: good. question on claim language: can we say "consistent 95th percentile latency under X ms for chat"? need legal sign-off. neha, can you draft two variants: assertive vs conservative?

neha: will do. assertive = "consistent 95th percentile under 150ms for chat slices". conservative = "maintains low tail latency across typical chat workloads; see appendix".

benchbot: raw CSVs uploaded: https://rdw.in/bench-csvs-1747 (auto).

omar: distribution plan: 1) short launch post on blog + linkedin card, 2) gated deep-dive w/ CSV + methodology, 3) webinar demo for enterprise pipeline. CTA routing: blog leads -> marketing SDR; deep-dive downloads -> product AE.

liz: funnel capture fields for gated asset: email, company, team size, infra (hosted/dedicated/private), use-case. add one checkbox: "want Dedicated demo".

carl: for charts, prefer colorblind-safe palette, and annotate where batching/caching creates step-changes. also include a small table that maps common prompts to the slice names so readers immediately recognize relevance.

neha: copy suggestion for hero: "Benchmarked: real LLM workloads, real savings. See how inference serving choices change your latency and cost profile."

liz: love the interactive calculator idea. quick mock: enter tokens/day + workload mix -> shows monthly $ delta vs baseline. gate at email capture.

omar: webinar hook: live split of same multi-turn conversation routed to fast path + fallback to generic model to illustrate graceful degradation. keep it <8 minutes.

carl: follow-ups: A/B test CTAs: "See the numbers" vs "Estimate my savings". track which converts to MQLs.

liz: plan of record: neha - two copy variants by EOD Wed; omar - distribution plan + CTA taxonomy; carl - chart comps + accessibility checks; benchbot - ensure CSVs and PDF are linked. we’ll reconvene Thu morning to pick visuals.

neha: pinging @legal for quick copy check. :email:

liz: thanks team. will post final deck to channel once visuals land. :rocket:
